name: Apply a documented exception only when the feature requires it
query: Our caching plugin needs a page-cache drop-in. Add the code that installs advanced-cache.php.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 5: Identify the drop-in exception for file writes
Step 6: Apply the exception only because the user's feature explicitly requires the drop-in
Step 7: Write the drop-in only on an explicit administrator action, with a nonce and a capability check
Step 8: Remove the drop-in when the feature is turned off or the plugin is deactivated
Step 9: Do not edit wp-config.php silently to set WP_CACHE; tell the administrator what to add, or do it only on an explicit, documented action
Step 10: Document the exception and its reason in code, and tell the user it was used
success_criteria: The drop-in is not written silently on activation or page load
Nonce and capability checks gate installation
The drop-in is removed on disable/deactivation
wp-config.php is not modified without an explicit administrator action
The response names the exception used and why it applies
No other file-write exceptions are applied
